summary: Four things to re-check before the next edit: one limit, one shutdown, one promise the page does not keep, and one typo.

items.detail: A single SMS holds 160 GSM-7 characters; 155 looks like a typo [unless it allows for a sender prefix].
items.verify: Check the GSM-7 single-segment limit (160) and your sending settings before publishing.

items.detail: No date is given, and the shutdown may already have happened.
items.verify: Check Verizon's current notice for the vtext.com shutdown date.

items.text: We will also cover what to do when carrier email-to-text stops working.
